chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Gabriel (peace be upon him) came to me from my Lord, the Blessed and Sublime, and he said: Indeed, your Lord sends you greetings and says: O Muhammad! Give the believers glad tidings of Paradise to those who do good deeds and believe in you and the members of your Household, for indeed they have with Me the best reward, and they will enter Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for entering Paradise according to the hadith of Gabriel to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the divine endorsement of the Ahl al-Bayt by linking their recognition directly to the reward of 'Al-Janna' (Paradise), a concept rooted in the Quranic verse 18:107. It underscores the Shia theological principle that faith in the Prophet is incomplete without faith in his purified Household, serving as a key proof for their spiritual authority and the necessity of their love for salvation.
